name: walkthrough
description: Walks a running web app the way a user would, through the Playwright MCP server, and says whether what it saw matches the step's proof. Saves screenshots as evidence. Returns match or concerns, or drift when it can quote the proof and a page that contradicts it; never gates.
when: at the verify pause of a step whose proof is something a person would check by hand in the browser; it costs 10 to 30 model turns, so bind it on those steps only, and start the app first or give it a start command
